deep_review.conclusion: Static integration review establishes the trust boundary: AES-GCM bridge transport and client Confirmed/UI Success states collect a result but do not grant application authorization. The connector URI carries exported ephemeral key material and must not be logged or shared beyond the intended verification flow. verifyCloudProof rejects browser use and performs remote verification, while the host must bind expected application/action/signal and enforce replay/nullifier policy. Custom bridge URL validation enforces HTTPS/root/default-port outside staging-localhost; domain restrictions are warnings, not an allowlist. Widget verification callbacks are optional, the HTML example leaves one empty, the headless demo logs sensitive URI/results, and the Next.js example accepts request-supplied expected values. These limits are retained with the assets; no proof service, cryptographic implementation or runtime was executed or independently certified.
